text:
aisha: Heads-up — Bluejay-v1 is scheduled to go live Tue 09:00 UTC (canary today). Perf team ran load sims; we need to discuss GPU-hour and routing impact.

leo: Got it. What are the numbers from the sims?

aisha: Summary from perf: median token throughput per A100-80GB instance (quantized runtime) ~ 11k tokens/sec for 512 context. Bluejay has a bursty arrival curve. We expect ~110k tokens/sec sustained for launch window with 220k tokens/sec short spikes (1–3m).

chen: So sustained 110k tps / 11k per GPU = ~10 GPUs sustained. For 220k spikes we hit ~20 GPUs if everything routes there. Do we have that headroom in the primary region?

morgan: Not in us-west-2 — reserved pool shows 12 A100 slots, 3 in warm state. APAC (asia-south1) only has 6 total reserved. EU has 8.

aisha: Right — region constraints mean we can’t absorb global spike in one region. Proposal: enable cross-region routing by latency policy (prefer us-west but failover to eu for excess), enable autoscale burst to Dedicated-burst tier. Also enable prefix/KV caching for popular prompts.

leo: Autoscale burst is limited by contract though — Dedicated-burst has a 30% cap unless we pre-approve. Do we have approval?

morgan: Sales/CS already approved a one-off burst increase for launch up to +40% for 6 hours (signed yesterday). That gets us from 12 -> ~16 GPUs in us-west. Still short of worst-case 20.

chen: Quick calc I pasted to the thread:
```
# rough calc
sustained_tps = 110000
per_gpu = 11000
gpus_sustained = ceil(sustained_tps / per_gpu)  # ~10
spike_tps = 220000
gpus_spike = ceil(spike_tps / per_gpu)  # ~20
```

aisha: Ops plan options: 1) Shift some requests to eu & apac (cold start cost + latency), 2) Enable model fallback to Bluejay-lite (7k tps/GPU) for non-critical endpoints, 3) Pre-warm extra Dedicated nodes in us-west for 2 hours around launch (cost hit). We should pick a mix.

leo: Preference: enable fallback + cross-region routing. Fallback reduces quality for a small % of requests but keeps latency within SLO. Can we target 30% of traffic to fallback during spikes?

morgan: We can implement traffic shaping via routing policy: rate-limit per-route and set fallback for the chat route. Also we can prime KV cache for top 200 prompts tonight — that'll shave ~15% token work per request for sessions that reuse prefixes.

chen: Cost estimate for pre-warm (if we need it): assume additional 8 A100s for 4 hours at $6/hr -> 8*4*6 = $192. If we pre-warm 16 instead of 8, double that. Also cross-region egress cost may add ~$0.01/1k tokens — ballpark.

aisha: Action items:
- @morgan can you set up routing policy and fallback by EOD? (include canary config)
- @leo coordinate with sales to confirm Dedicated-burst + pre-warm approval for additional 4 GPUs if needed
- @chen run a targeted KV pre-warm job tonight for top prompt set and report cache hit % by 06:00 UTC
- infra-bot schedule a dry-run canary at 23:00 UTC tonight (scale to 30% synthetic traffic)

morgan: On it. I'll push a canary config: route primary->us-west (100ms penalty threshold) -> overflow->eu; fallback model Bluejay-lite for chat.create with 30% cap. Will post PR and request review.

leo: Sales confirmed: we can get +4 GPUs as emergency burst (manual approval) and +40% autoscale for 6 hours is green. I'll DM legal to confirm billing.

chen: Pre-warm job submitted. Initial run shows KV prefix cache hit ~12% after seeding top 50 prompts. I'll iterate to 200 prompts.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled by aisha for 1937608280 (23:00 UTC). Will run synthetic traffic at 30% target, notify channel on completion.

aisha: Thanks. Last note on telemetry: please enable token-level tracing for the canary and tag metrics with "bluejay.launch" so product can correlate errors. If we see latency > 250ms p95 on the lite fallback, rollback to throttling.

morgan: Will add trace tag and p95 alert. I'll also add a temporary dashboard tile showing GPU utilization by region.

leo: I'll stand by for manual burst approval during launch. If we hit >85% util in us-west for 2 consecutive minutes, I'll trigger.

aisha: Great — let's regroup 1 hour before go-time in #eng-infra. Keep updates short in this thread. :thumbsup:
